summary: Documentation advertises flags and behaviors that the implementation does not provide or contradicts.

findings.title: Docs advertise --count, but code implements --times
findings.evidence: README usage and docs/cli.md describe `--count`, while src/cli.py adds `--times` and checks `args.times`.
findings.suggested_fix: Rename the implemented flag to `--count` or update all documentation to `--times`.
findings.verification_notes: Fixture intentionally planted; confirmed against fixture source.

findings.title: Docs say missing files exit 0, but code exits 2
findings.evidence: README and docs/cli.md state exit code 0 for missing files, but src/cli.py returns 2 when `args.path` does not exist.
findings.suggested_fix: Make the implementation return 0 for missing files or update docs to state exit code 2.
findings.verification_notes: Fixture intentionally planted; confirmed against fixture source.

findings.title: Docs claim glob and recursive support, but code does not implement it
findings.evidence: README says it supports globs like `src/**/*.py`, and docs/cli.md documents `--recursive`, but src/cli.py only accepts a single `Path` and has no glob expansion or recursive handling.
findings.suggested_fix: Implement glob/recursive expansion or remove those claims from the documentation.
findings.verification_notes: Fixture intentionally planted; confirmed against fixture source.
